title: Purification, Molecular Docking and Cytotoxicity Evaluation of Bioactive Pentacyclic Polyhydroxylated Triterpenoids from Salvia urmiensis.
authors: Farimani, Mahdi Moridi; Abbas-Mohammadi, Mahdi; Ghorbannia-Dellavar, Samira; Nejad-Ebrahimi, Samad; Hamburger, Matthias
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中纯化三萜类化合物并进行分子对接评估其对NF-κB蛋白的抑制，虽涉及蛋白对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Triterpenoids, as one of the largest classes of naturally occurring secondary metabolites in higher plants, are of interest due to their high structural diversity and wide range of biological activities. In addition to several promising pharmacological activities such as antimicrobial, antiviral, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and hepatoprotective effects, a large number of triterpenoids have revealed high potential for cancer therapy through their strong cytotoxicity on cancer cell lines and, also, low toxicity in normal cells. So, this study was aimed at discovering novel and potentially bioactive triterpenoids from the Salvia urmiensis species. For this, an ethyl acetate fraction of the acetone extract of the aerial parts of the plant was chromatographed to yield five novel polyhydroxylated triterpenoids (1: -5: ). Their structure was elucidated by extensive spectroscopic methods including 1D ((1)H, (13)C, DEPT-Q) and 2D NMR (COSY, HSQC, HMBC, NOESY) experiments, as well as HRESIMS analysis. Cytotoxic activity of the purified compounds was also investigated by MTT assay against the MCF-7 cancer cell line. Furthermore, a molecular docking analysis was applied to evaluate the inhibition potential of the ligands against the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) protein, which promotes tumor metastasis or affects gene expression in cancer disease. The 1beta,11beta,22alpha-trihydroxy-olean-12-ene-3-one (compound 4: ) indicated the best activity in both in vitro and in silico assays, with an IC(50) value of 32 microM and a docking score value of - 3.976 kcal/mol, respectively.
abstract_zh: 三萜类化合物作为高等植物中最大类别的天然次生代谢产物之一，因其高度的结构多样性和广泛的生物活性而备受关注。除了若干有前景的药理活性，如抗菌、抗病毒、抗氧化、抗炎和保肝作用外，大量三萜类化合物还通过其对癌细胞系的强细胞毒性和对正常细胞的低毒性，显示出在癌症治疗中的巨大潜力。因此，本研究旨在从Salvia urmiensis物种中发现新型且具有潜在生物活性的三萜类化合物。为此，对该植物地上部分的丙酮提取物中的乙酸乙酯组分进行了色谱分离，得到五种新型多羟基三萜类化合物（1: -5:）。通过包括一维（(1)H, (13)C, DEPT-Q）和二维NMR（COSY, HSQC, HMBC, NOESY）实验以及HRESIMS分析在内的广泛光谱方法阐明了它们的结构。还通过MTT法对纯化化合物针对MCF-7癌细胞系的细胞毒活性进行了研究。此外，应用分子对接分析评估了配体对核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）蛋白的抑制潜力，该蛋白在癌症中促进肿瘤转移或影响基因表达。1beta,11beta,22alpha-三羟基-齐墩果-12-烯-3-酮（化合物4:）在体外和计算机模拟试验中均显示出最佳活性，其IC(50)值为32微摩尔，对接分数值为-3.976 kcal/mol。
